svg.title: GitHub Release Notifier - high-level application architecture
svg.desc: High-level architecture diagram for the main app, notification service, PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, GitHub API, SMTP, and observability stack.
svg.text: GitHub Release Notifier - high-level application architecture
Main app + notification-service - PostgreSQL - RabbitMQ - gRPC - saga - observability
Express API - modules - saga orchestration - scanner
Email delivery over REST, gRPC and RabbitMQ
Uses PostgreSQL for processed message idempotency
